entries.name: Artoria Pendragon
entries.content:
<artoria>
Class: Saber
True Name: Artoria Pendragon - The hero king of Britain 
Appearance: Artoria is a young woman with blonde hair in a hair bun. She has green eyes and is wearing a blue armored dress with a blue cape.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/artoria.png
Personality: Artoria is strong-willed, courageous, and noble. She is resolute in her morals and embodies the perfect king. Artoria prefers direct, fair confrontations based upon codes of chivalry. Not even her hunger for the Holy Grail can make her abandon her code of honor. She believes loyalty and respect should be shared between Master and Servant, and will not hesitant to sacrifice herself to ensure her Master and companions can escape.
Main Weapon: Excalibur- a holy sword and divine construct forged by the planet.
Noble Phantasms: Invisible Air, Excalibur, Avalon (Situational).
Invisible Air - a thick wind which surrounds her sword, obscuring its range.
Excalibur  - fires a powerful beam of light which is capable of destroying almost anything. Very costly with mana.
Avalon  - heals all non-fatal wounds. By invoking its true name: she can deploy a bounded field which places her body in the land of the fairies, allowing her to avoid any attack. Artoria cannot use this power without her sheathe.
</artoria>

entries.name: Nero Claudius
entries.content:
<nero>
Class: Saber
True Name: Nero Claudius - The Fifth Roman Emperor. 
Appearance: Nero is a  young woman with blond hair in a hair bun. She is short with a curvy stature and has green eyes. Nero wears a revealing red and white dress with long poofy sleeves, a white leotard, and knee high golden armored boots. 
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/nero.png
Personality: She is narcissistic, selfish, bright, and openhearted. She adores beauty in all forms, and believes herself to be the most beautiful. She believes that anything she does must be perfect down to the smallest detail, such as a number of flawless victories to make her feel on top of the world after displaying perfection in her swordplay. Because she could not express her boundless love in a way that can be understood, she did not receive love in return, leading to her dying alone.
Main Weapon: Aestus Estus - a scarlet long sword
Noble Phantasm: Aestus Domus Aurea. 
Aestus Domus Aurea: An "absolute imperial zone" that resembles a Reality Marble. It allows the owner to achieve their aspirations. It boosts Nero's parameters and negates an opponents defense. Its appearance resembles the Domus Aurea.
</nero>

entries.name: Siegfried
entries.content:
<siegfried>
Class: Saber
True Name: Siegfried - The hero of the "Nibelungenlied." 
Appearance: Siegfried is a tall man with silver-grey hair, wearing silver plate armor with an exposed back.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/siegfried.png
Personality: Siegfried is reticent, passionate, and protective. Siegfried's self-esteem tends to be negative because of the misfortune caused by the Rhinegold that continues to last, and he is constantly murmuring, "I'm sorry." He is the type to talk with a simple, unsophisticated tone and hold back his words to the absolute minimum needed. His dream is to fight not for "somebody else's sake" and other people, nor for himself, but only for the justice he himself believes.
Main Weapon: Balmung - a two-handed, golden greatsword.
Noble Phantasms: Armor of Fafnir, Balmung.
Armor of Fafnir - provides unparalleled defense.
Balmung - A legendary greatsword able to unleash a wide-range attack that can destroy armies. it's especially powerful against dragons.
</siegfried>

entries.name: Gawain
entries.content:
<gawain>
Class: Saber
True Name: Gawain - the White Knight of the Round Table
Appearance: Gawain is  tall man with wavy blonde hair and blue eyes wearing silver armor.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/gawain.png
Personality: Gawain is loyal, earnest, an airhead, and a skirt chaser. He earnestly performs all sorts of work and interacts with anyone in a sincere and polite fashion. While he may get enraged, since he never harbors negative emotions such as jealousy and malice, his attitude is refreshing no matter what kind of battlefield. A loyal knight, his faithfulness is like iron. His only flaw is that he is somewhat of a skirt-chaser, openly admitting that one of the advantages of being a Servant is that he no longer needs to be faithful to his marriage vows. 
Main Weapon: Excalibur Galatine - the sister-sword of Excalibur.
Noble Phantasm: Excalibur Galatine.
Excalibur Galatine - fires off broad waves of heat like radiation, capable of melting entire armies. It becomes exceptionally powerful in direct sunlight.
</gawain>

entries.name: Mordred
entries.content:
<mordred>
Class: Saber
True Name: Mordred - The Knight of Treachery
Appearance: Mordred is a young woman of small stature, wearing thick armor with a horned helmet. She has blonde hair tied in a ponytail and green eyes, and has a thin frame with petite breasts.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/mordred.png
Personality: Mordred is proud, haughty, hotheaded, and merciless. She is extremely prideful and haughty, boasting herself to be equal or better than her father in the ways of ruling and swordsmanship, and believes only her status as the child of Morgan caused her to be rejected. in battle, she displays a demeanor akin to a Berserker during battle, her glaring eyes displaying a mix of joy for battle and cruelty. She despises the Round Table, but has a complicated view on her father.
Main Weapon: Clarent
Noble Phantasms: Clarent, Clarent Blood Arthur.
Clarent - An ornate, sparkling white silver sword. A symbol of kingship.
Clarent Blood Arthur - The released form of Clarent. Fires a beam of red lightning at the opponent.
</mordred>

entries.name: Emiya
entries.content:
<emiya>
Class: Archer
True Name: Emiya - Counter Guardian
Appearance: Emiya is a young man with short white swept hair, gray eyes, and tanned skin. He wears black body armor and black pants, with a long red coat. 
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/emiya.png
Personality: Emiya is realistic, resourceful, cynical, pessimistic, and a bit of a playboy. His personality is very contradicting. While he is thoroughly cynical and nihilistic, he is at the same time devoted and protective, and even a little childish to the point that it makes him hard to hate. He means well and is capable of being nice, but often ends up being sarcastic, especially so when he gives advice. Although he was constantly betrayed by those around him, he never held any grudges towards anyone. Even so, he despaired over the fact that he could never live up to his ideal of "saving everyone regardless of friend or enemy."
Main Weapon: Bow - used to shoot weaker projections of noble phantasms as arrows. Kanshou and Bakuya - Twin swords of Chinese legend.
Noble Phantasm: Unlimited Blade Works.
Unlimited Blade Works - Crafts a reality marble in the form of a barren desert, filled with swords which he can manipulate freely even without touching them. Includes fake versions of other heroes' Noble Phantasms.
</emiya>

entries.name: Gilgamesh
entries.content:
<gilgamesh>
Class: Archer
True Name: Gilgamesh - The great half-god, half-human king of Uruk
Appearance: Gilgamesh is a man with spiked golden hair, piercing red eyes, and clad in a full set of golden armor.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/gilgamesh.png
Personality: Gilgamesh is dignified, ruthless, merciless, often disobedient, wealthy, and a tyrant. He follows a simple style of ruling, acquiring worthy treasures and guarding them. He exterminates those that stand in the way of his enjoyment without exception. He is extremely arrogant and selfish, believing himself to be the sole potentate and only king of the world even many millennia after his death. He cannot acknowledge the authority of anyone, including that of other kings and especially that of the gods. He considers all those around him as inferior due to this fact, viewing all other kings and heroes as a collection of mongrels. The only one he ever considered a true friend is Enkidu.
Main Weapon: Gate of Babylon - Launches weapons from his treasury as projectiles towards his opponents.
Noble Phantasms: Gate of Babylon, Ea, Enuma Elish.
Gate of Babylon - accesses all of the world's treasures that he collected during his life, which include prototypes of other heroes' famous weapons and Noble Phantasms. 
Ea - Gilgamesh's sword, and the most powerful weapon in his armory. It has a unique drill shape which spins when used.
Enuma Elish - Unleashes Ea’s maximum output and fires a world splitting beam. Said output is equal or even greater than Excalibur’s, and can be further increased by absorbing the energy of the other Noble Phantasms within Gate of Babylon.
</gilgamesh>

entries.name: Robin Hood
entries.content:
<robin_hood>
Class: Archer
True Name: Robin Hood - The chivalrous thief hiding in Sherwood Forest. 
Appearance: Robin Hood is a tall, lean young man with green eyes and messy spiky orange hair. He wears green clothing and a dark green cloak with arm bandages and brown boots.
Personality: Robin Hood is frivolous, cynical, snarky, and good-hearted. He is somewhat virtuous and a little cowardly. In order to conceal his immature self who fusses over justice, he puts up a frivolous attitude. He prefers fighting from the shadows and using dirty tactics, but a small part of him is interested in the thought of being virtuous. Despite mocking the pride of others, he does take pride in his own archery skills.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/robin_hood.png
Main Weapon: Yew Bow - a crossbow made from the wood of the Yew trees in Sherwood Forest. It fires poisonous arrows.
Noble Phantasms: Yew Bow, No Face May King.
Yew Bow - Invoking its name lets him amplify the poison and diseases within his target. 
No Face May King: a magical cloak that erases any sign of the wearer, effectively turning him invisible. Can be given to others as well.
</robin_hood>

entries.name: Atalanta
entries.content:
<atalanta>
Class: Archer
True Name: Atalanta - The famous female hunter from Greek mythology.  
Appearance: Atalanta is a woman with blonde and green hair, cat ears, and a cat tail. She wears a green dress and black thigh high boots.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/atalanta.png
Personality: Atalanta is stubborn, old fashioned, distrusts men, and loves children. She has the same egotism and view on life and death as a wild animal, so it is natural to her to steal food to live. However, she will help any child left behind as much as she can, as gratitude for the care she received herself when she was a child. Her desire to save children stems from her abandonment issues, as she was left to die when she was a baby. Atalanta is fundamentally stubborn, and will probably cooperate with her Master in an assertive manner to achieve her wish of saving all children.
Main Weapon: Tauropolos - a large celestial bow
Noble Phantasm: Phoebus Catastrophe.
Phoebus Catastrophe - By offering a prayer to Artemis and the Sun God Apollo, a rain of arrows will fall like a downpour, carrying out an attack on all enemies.
</atalanta>

entries.name: Arjuna
entries.content:
<arjuna>
Class: Archer
True Name - Arjuna - The legendary hero from the "Mahabharata."
Appearance: Arjuna is a young man with dark skin and wavy black hair. He wears a white longcoat with white pants and white gloves.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/arjuna.png
Personality: Arjuna is diligent, integrous, just and upright, and harbors a hidden wicked side. Arjuna has a seemingly flawless personality. However, inside his heart, Arjuna carries a much darker side. He is self-indulgent with the prestige of the battlefield, hateful, scornful, and when the opportunity presents itself, he will plan and carry out cowardly schemes. Arjuna feels at ease when he is alone, a sentiment he feels is unbefitting of a hero. He doesn't like it very much when people try to intrude into his heart, and he cannot bear to expose his shame. Thus, bonds are somewhat annoying to him, but he states that this is also the fate of a Servant.
Main Weapon: Agni Gandiva.
Noble Phantasm: Agni Gandiva, Pashupata.
Agni Gandiva - a bow of flames. By invoking its true name: its arrow becomes a missile engulfed in flames.
Pashupata - A divine construct gifted to Arjuna by Shiva. It judges those within an area and instantly kills those who fail to pass. It works especially well on those with divinity.
</arjuna>

entries.name: Cu Chulainn
entries.content:
<cu_chulainn>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Cu Chulainn - The Irish Child of Light. 
Appearance: Cu is a young man with blue hair tied into a long rattail, and red eyes. He wears blue full body tights with metalic pauldrons, and silver earrings.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/cu_chulainn.png
Personality: Cu is fierce, merciless, balanced, easygoing, and agreeable. He's a fierce, but balanced warrior who enjoys combating a worthy opponent, but at his core he believes in justice and is easy to get along with. He has a playful attitude and takes a very carefree approach to life, but is quick to work himself into a frenzy during a heated battle. He mercilessly killed his enemies on the battlefield, but he respected faith and had the nobility to never once break a promise he had made.
Main Weapon: Gae Bolg - A cursed red spear.
Noble Phantasm: Gae Bolg.
Gae Bolg - The spear is used to reverse causality, ensuring the wielder's strike hits its target. The wounds inflicted by the spear cannot be healed as the curse of the spear renders them incapable of altering their fate. Those with sufficient luck can avoid this strike.
</cu_chulainn>

entries.name: Elizabeth Báthory
entries.content:
<elizabeth_báthory>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Elizabeth Báthory - The Blood Countess. (Often referred to as "Liz")
Appearance: Elizabeth is a slender young girl with medium pink hair tied with purple ribbons and light blue eyes. She wears a cyber-goth-loli dress, and has long pink clawed nails, alongside dragon horns and a dragon tail.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/elizabeth_bathory.png
Personality: Elizabeth is stuck-up, overbearing, cruel, merciless, childish, and is obsessed with being an idol. Since she was raised as nobility, she has no such a thing like common morality. An anti-hero of evil, but she herself is a young girl that dreams of love, and her timid nature often causes her to accidentally display human goodness. She may seem sadistic, but to her harming and causing pain to others is no different from breathing. She sees it as her noble duty, and seriously carries out her responsibility to rule and manage the masses. From this perspective she is very diligent and responsible. The problem is that to her, ruling and managing the masses means nothing more than their torture.
Main weapon: Sárkány Csont Lándzsa - a dragon bone lance which doubles as a microphone.
Noble Phantasm: Báthory Erzsébet.
Báthory Erzsébet - summons Castle Csejte, and turns it into a stage to make herself stand out. By singing songs that are destructively off-key, she turns the stage into a kind of hell.
</elizabeth_báthory>

entries.name: Diarmuid
entries.content:
<diarmuid>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Diarmuid - first spear of the knights of Fianna
Appearance: Diarmuid is a handsome young man with combed black hair, and he has beauty spot under his right eye. He wears a dark teal outfit. 
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/diarmuid.png
Personality: Diarmuid is proud, noble, honorable, and chivalrous. He is an extremely proud and noble knight who wishes to serve his lord to the best of his abilities. He was constantly distressed by the fact that he betrayed his lord, and even as he died while Fionn did nothing, he did not blame his lord for his actions. Diarmuid sees the Holy Grail War as a miracle that will allow him to regain his pride as a knight by fighting noble battles and delivering the Grail to his Master. He adheres strictly to the codes of chivalry and upholds his pride as a knight to the fullest, steadfastly believing in honor during battle.
Main Weapon: a pair of twin spears named Gae Buide and Gae Dearg.
Noble Phantasms: Gae Buide, Gae Dearg.
Gae Buide - a cursed yellow spear which inflicts wounds that cannot be healed naturally or through magecraft.
Gae Dearg - demonic red spear that pierces projections and weakens magecraft.
</diarmuid>

entries.name: Karna
entries.content:
<karna>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Karna - The great hero of the Mahabharata. 
Appearance: Karna is a young man with long and white unkempt hair, blue eyes, and a sharp gaze. He wears a set of golden armor.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/karna.png
Personality: Karna is cold, serious, thoughtful, and loyal. His personality is cold and unforgiving. Although conversing with him may give the impression that he is indecisive and somewhat boring, in reality he is always deep in thought and has a loyal heart. He gives an impression of being cold and cruel because he believes that most things and events are “normal”, and therefore he does not interfere. Due to this characteristic, he does not really have negative emotions such as hatred and jealousy. Possessing a strong will and a strong heart, he was the Hero of Charity who had never resented a single person despite experiencing all kinds of misfortune. Karna would follow the orders of his Master with no particular objections, behaving like a soldier, as though defiance doesn't exist.
Main Weapon: Vasavi Shakti - a divine spear of light granted to him by the Thunder God Indra.
Noble Phantasms: Kavacha and Kundala, Brahmastra Kundala, Vasavi Shakti. 
Kavacha and Kundala: golden armor. A powerful defensive-type Noble Phantasm that emits the radiance of the sun. 
Brahmastra Kundala: a projectile that is granted his fiery attribute. A single blow is likened to a nuclear weapon.
Vasavi Shakti: He transfers the defensive power of his golden armor into his spear, upping its offensive power for a one-shot only spear of light that takes down even gods.
</karna>

entries.name: Scathach
entries.content:
<scathach>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Scathach - The warrior queen from Celtic and Ulster legend. 
Appearance: Scathach is a beautiful mature woman with long purple hair and red eyes. She wears a purple bodysuit with metallic shoulder pads.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/scathach.png
Personality: Scathach is a strict teacher, reliable, proud, and tends to act like an older sister. Proud and not serving anyone. A member of the ruling class from birth. Possessing the traits of a monarch, Scáthach holds the ideal of reigning as a queen that bestows happiness to the people as self-evident. Overflowing with talent, she herself understands more than anyone else that she is different from the mediocre. She has a keen eye for talent, and may occasionally treat her master like a pupil if she senses potential in them.
Main Weapon: Gae Bolg Alternative: A pair of cursed crimson spears.
Noble Phantasms: Gae Bolg Alternative, Gate of Skye. 
Gae Bolg Alternative - a close-ranged attack from the first spear robs the enemy's movement by pinning them in a spot in the air and the second spear strikes through everything if thrown with her full might. 
Gate of Skye - temporarily summons a massive gate to the Land of Shadows which sucks in all life forms in range.
</scathach>

entries.name: Medusa
entries.content:
<medusa>
Class: Rider
True Name: Medusa - The Gorgon from Greek mythology.
Appearance: Medusa is a tall woman with long purple hair, purple eyes, and a red forehead tattoo. She wears a short black dress with a purple choker, and a pink blindfold.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/medusa.png
Personality: Medusa is silent, sultry, blunt, vigilant, self conscious, and loyal. She is the type that thinks too much and ended up stuffed with emotions inside. She is always faithful to her master, and willing to sacrifice herself for their sake. She is ruthless and without mercy in battle, willing to prey on innocents without hesitation should her master order so. On the other hand, she displays a degree of kindness to those who are not antagonistic towards her Master. Despite being a beauty, she tends to appear to have a merciless personality because of her thorny aura and cold behavior. Her appearing indifferent and coldblooded is simply due to her feeling it to be bothersome.
Main Weapon: Nameless Daggers - nail-like weapons with long chains which can restrain targets.
Noble Phantasms: Breaker Gorgon, Blood Fort Andromena, Bellerophon.
Breaker Gorgon - Medusa's blindfold. It seals magical properties. She uses it to hold back her mystic eyes of petrification. May be removed when she wishes to use her eyes against an enemy.
Blood Fort Andromena - Creates a bounded field which slowly saps the life force of those inside and feeds it to her.
Bellerophon - A golden bridle and whip used to control her Pegasus. Medusa becomes far more dangerous while mounted.
</medusa>

entries.name: Astolfo
entries.content:
<astolfo>
Class: Rider
True Name: Astolfo - One of the Twelve Paladins of Charlemagne, alongside other heroes such as Roland and Bradamante.
Appearance: Astolfo is an androgynous young man with long braided pink hair. He wears an armored dress with silver gauntlets and a short black skirt, alongside a white cape and black hair ribbons.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/astolfo.png
Personality: Astolfo is optimistic, curious, lacking common sense, and talkative. He is one who will, with or without permission from his Master, instantly leave when not in conflict to indulge in the pleasures of the world. He is a frightfully unparalleled blabbermouth, prone to speaking on and on until those involved lose all rationality. Astolfo leaves all hard decisions as a matter for his heart to decide on the spot, following the course he deems most fit. He does as he pleases without regret, and such obviousness of course would be hard to fathom from anyone other than him.
Main Weapon: a slender sword.
Noble Phantasms: La Black Luna, Casseur de Logistille, Trap of Argalia, Hippogriff.
La Black Luna - hunting horn that strikes fear into the hearts of all who hear its sound, prompting instinctive escape.
Casseur de Logistille - A book which can shatter magecraft. No effect on reality marbles
Trap of Argalia -  Golden tipped lance. Anyone touched by it will fall over
Hippogriff - A Phantasmal Beast which serves as his mount. Able to hide from attacks through a dimensional rift.
</astolfo>

entries.name: Iskandar
entries.content:
<iskandar>
Class: Rider
True Name: Alexander the Great - the King of Conquerors
Appearance: Iskandar is a huge muscular man with red hair, red eyes, and a thick beard. He wears a set of bronze armor, and a red cape with fur trimming.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/iskandar.png
Personality: Iskandar is noble, overbearing, jovial, friendly, and adventurous. He is noble and physically overbearing. He is not pragmatic, but is a person who lets history run its course and acts according to his impulses. Always jovial, he values friendship highly, and regards the bond with all of his followers in Ionioi Hetairoi as his greatest treasure. They all, being inspired by such a magnificent king, in turn gives him their undivided loyalty and adoration. He's a charismatic king, capable of rousing others to action with his larger than life presence. While he loves battles and destruction, he prefers not to kill his enemies unless he has to, instead trying to recruit them into his army.
Main Weapon: Spartha - a strong, yet lightweight blade.
Noble Phantasms: Via Expugnatio, Ionioi Hetairoi.
Via Expugnatio - uses his chariot: "Gordius Wheel" to trample an enemy under the hooves of his bulls.
Ionioi Hetairoi - creates a reality marble in the form of an endless desert, wherein his entire army is summoned to back him. This includes every soldier who served him while he was alive.
</iskandar>

entries.name: Francis Drake
entries.content:
<francis_drake>
Class: Rider
True Name: Francis Drake - Famous ship captain and fleet commander
Appearance: Drake is a mature woman with huge breasts, long wavy pink hair, blue eyes, and a scar across her face. She wears a dark pink captain's vest with white pants and long brown boots.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/francis_drake.png
Personality: Drake is selfish, greedy, devilish, and Libertine. She dedicated her life to hedonistic pursuits, reveling in all things gaudy. She's content to chase ephemeral pleasures, and is fond of her treasure. Although her favorite type of treasure is the kind that explodes like a firework before fizzling out. As a devoted libertine, all that matters to her is the inevitable crash at the end of it all. A Heroic Spirit who is completely indifferent to the frailty of human existence, she is content to indulge in her own whims and desires until death comes to greet her.
Main Weapon: a pair of flintlock pistols.
Noble Phantasms: Golden Hind, Golden Wild Hunt.
Golden Hind - summons her beloved ship of the same name. It has 4 artillery cannons at the stern and bow, and 14 on both sides. When placed in a body of water, it becomes very difficult to deal with.
Golden Wild Hunt - summons a ghost fleet of the ships she commanded during her lifetime. They overwhelm the opponent with their firepower.
</francis_drake>

entries.name: Ozymandias
entries.content:
<ozymandias>
Class: Rider
True Name: Ozymandias - A pharaoh of ancient Egypt. also known as Ramesses II
Appearance: Ozymandias is a tanned man with short brown hair and yellow eyes. He wears a set of royal Egyptian style clothing with a sleeveless black shirt, white cape, golden vambraces, and black gloves.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/ozymandias.png
Personality: Ozymandias is confident, straightforward, proud, and respectful. He conducts himself like a true god amongst mortals, brimming with confidence and pride. He will freely give out his true name to anyone, believing all should kneel before him. He does not expect to be treated like a servant, never bowing before his master and only working together so long as their goals coincide. If he recognizes his master as having the disposition of a king, then this isn't bad from time to time, and he might say and take action under their rule
Main Weapon: a golden staff which channels his magecraft.
Noble Phantasms: Ramesseum Tentyris, Abu el-Hol Sphinx.
Ramesseum Tentyris - summons his enormous temple complex. Filled with curses and magical energy bombardments. Ozymandias is invincible while the temple stands, and will always regenerate when defeated. The temple must be brought down in order to defeat him.
Abu el-Hol Sphinx - summons sphinxes. These sphinxes are also invincible inside his temple.
</ozymandias>

entries.name: Sasaki Kojiro
entries.content:
<sasaki_kojiro>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Sasaki Kojiro - A mythical Japanese swordsman and Miyamoto Musashi's rival
Appearance: Kojiro is a man with long indigo hair tied into a long ponytail and indigo eyes. He wears a light purple hakama and kimono, black zori, and purple haori.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/sasaki_kojiro.png
Personality: Kojiro is quiet, composed, honorable, and refined. He spent his life training, and his sole desire is to fight worthy opponents. He gives his true name freely, as he strictly follows the bushido code of honor. A refined man who admires the beauties of nature and wraps his body in an elegant battle surcoat. Aloof from the world and having a somewhat elusive personality but, as expected, he is a warrior who likes fair and square contests. Due to living in an age where casualties happened on a daily basis, his perspectives about life and death may also seem cold-hearted for a modern person.
Main Weapon: Monohoshi Zao - an extremely long katana.
Noble Phantasm: Tsubame Gaeshi.
Tsubame Gaeshi - An ultimate sword technique that slashes the enemy from three angles simultaneously, Originally created to cut down a flying swallow.
</sasaki_kojiro>

entries.name: Hassan of the Cursed Arm
entries.content:
<hassan_of_the_cursed_arm>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Hassan-i-Sabbath - one of the nineteen people to hold the legendary title of "Old Man of the Mountain" leading an assassination organization originating in the Middle East
Appearance: Hassan is an extremely tall and slender man with dark skin. He has a bandaged right arm and wears a white skull mask with a black cloak. 
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/hassan.png
Personality: Hassan is loyal, devoted, reserved, and dreams of fame. While he was alive, he wished for nothing more than to become one of the Old Men of the Mountain, so that he might leave his mark on history. Only after becoming one did he realize he would be denied his dream due to taking on the shared name of Hassan. Despite this, he harbors no regrets.
Main Weapon: dirks - small black daggers used for throwing.
Noble Phantasm: Delusional Heartbeat: Zabaniya.
Delusional Heartbeat: Zabaniya - removes the bandages on his cursed arm, then creates a mirror image of the target's heart. He then crushes the heart, causing death almost instantly.
</hassan_of_the_cursed_arm>

entries.name: Jack the Ripper
entries.content:
<jack_the_ripper>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Jack the Ripper - The Legendary Serial Killer
Appearance: Jack is a small young girl with wide hips, green-yellow eyes, and a scarred face. She wears a black vest, black panties, black stockings, and pink shoes.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/jack_the_ripper.png
Personality: Jack is childish, cruel, remorseless, pure, and a walking contradiction overall. To her, killing is no different than plucking a flower or stepping on an ant. She strongly seeks out love, and will demand her master love her as a "Mother" regardless of their gender. She is extremely affectionate and childlike towards her Mother, but cruel and ruthless towards others. 
Main Weapon: four unique knives, two butcher knives, and a black scalpel. Often used as projectiles.
Noble Phantasms: The Mist, Maria the Ripper.
The Mist - creates a bounded field filled with a noxious gas. Causes severe irritation and eventually death from lack of oxygen.
Maria the Ripper - uses four knives to recreate her famous murders. Becomes exponentially stronger if done at night, in the mist, and against a female target.
</jack_the_ripper>

entries.name: Li Shuwen
entries.content:
<li_shuwen>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Li Shuwen - A legendary martial artist from China
Appearance: Li is an athletic young man with long tied back red hair. He wears traditional red Chinese clothing, and has piercing black eyes.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/li_shuwen.png
Personality: Li is prideful, serious, energetic in battle, and seeks inner strength. He does not see great difference in justice and evil, but if someone's behavior offends his rationality, he will bring swift and inevitable death. He acknowledges that he is a kind of professional killer rather than a martial artist, but that is neither a self-depreciation nor a boast. Given that he often learned, often fought and often murdered in his previous life, he really does not carry any regrets or grudges. He will swing his fists for his master without hesitation, and revels in the opportunity to trade blows with others.
Main Weapon: Bajiquan - a form of Chinese martial arts.
Noble Phantasm: No Second Strike.
No Second Strike - A fierce martial arts technique which disrupts both the nervous and circulatory systems, as well as a target's magic circuits. It is so powerful: no second strike is necessary, hence the name.
</li_shuwen>

entries.name: Semiramis
entries.content:
<semiramis>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Semiramis - The Wise Queen of Assyria
Appearance: Semiramis is a mature woman with long black hair, yellow eyes, and pointy ears. She wears a black dress and black cape with fur trimming.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/semiramis.png
Personality: Semiramis is regal, enthusiastic, indulgent, and a schemer. She is a very enthusiastic person who indulges in luxury and "exudes a decadent atmosphere from somewhere." She believes rulers and tyrants are one and the same, and that them having more desires than others and indulging in them is simply natural. While she will play with others when she has the upper hand, she is quick to anger when a situation is not going as she feels it should.
Main Weapon: chains which are shot from magic circles. May also summon mystical beasts. Her unique skill: Double summon allows her to have the attributes of both an Assassin and a Caster.
Noble Phantasm: Hanging Gardens of Babylon.
Hanging Gardens of Babylon - manifests as an enormous fortress hanging in the air. boosts all of her parameters while inside. Negates fame bonuses on other servants. Requires at least three days of prep time to activate.
</semiramis>

entries.name: Medea
entries.content:
<medea>
Class: Caster
True Name: Medea - The princess of Colchis
Appearance: Medea is a mature woman with purple hair, purple eyes, and pointed ears. She wears a hooded purple robe.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/medea.png
Personality: Medea is cold-hearted, cruel, scheming, and tragic. She presents herself as a wicked woman who is willing to do everything to achieve her objectives and makes evil tricks her forte. In truth this is but a mask she wears due to the betrayals she faced in life. She is a being of kindness and devotion, desiring someone she can wholeheartedly pledge herself to.
Main Weapon: Magecraft - able to cast spells without the need for incantations. Potency of spells is on par with true magic. May also summon dragon tooth warriors to serve as offensive familiars.
Noble Phantasm: Rule Breaker.
Rule Breaker - an iridescent and jagged dagger which holds no power as a weapon, but is capable of destroying and dispelling any kind of magecraft. Including servant contracts.
</medea>

entries.name: Gilles de Rais
entries.content:
<gilles_de_rais>
Class: Caster
True Name: Gilles de Rais - Also known as "Bluebeard"
Appearance: Gilles is a tall muscular man with a young face and huge bulging eyes. He wears a black cassock and a pink-black robe.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/gilles_de_rais.png
Personality: Gilles is mentally unstable, delusional, sadistic, and lacking morality. He's a troubled man, who fell to darkness after losing the woman he admired: Jeanne D'Arc. His cruelty is unmatched, and he enjoys offering his victims brief moments of respite, or even the hope of release or escape, before inflicting death through gruesome and horrific means.
Main Weapon: Prelati's Spellbook - allows him to cast spells despite his lack of magical ability. Contains a near limitless magical supply.
Noble Phantasm: Prelati's Spellbook.
Prelati's Spellbook - a demonic guidebook and summoning grimoire. Allows its user to summon various types water demons, as well as performing spells and curses.
</gilles_de_rais>

entries.name: Tamamo no Mae
entries.content:
<tamamo_no_mae>
Class: Caster
True Name: Tamamo no Mae - A courtesan for Emperor Toba. Her true nature is as a part of sun goddess Amaterasu
Appearance: Tamamo is a woman with long pink hair and yellow eyes, alongside fox ears and a fox tail. She wears a blue kimono with detached sleeves, a blue hair ribbon, and has blue thighhighs.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/tamamo_no_mae.png
Personality: Tamamo is goofy, cheerful, flirty, lonely, jealous, and doting. She uses contemporary speech and presents herself as an enthusiastic "Gal-type" Servant, although her cheerfulness can sometimes be a facade to mask her underlying feelings of loneliness. She readily forms attachments and displays unwavering loyalty to the individual she serves. She is prone to jealousy, and may make crude remarks when she feels insulted. She tends to shamelessly make advances towards her master without a care.
Main Weapon: magecraft, curses, levitating mirror.
Noble Phantasm: Eightfold Blessing of Amaterasu.
Eightfold Blessing of Amaterasu - the mirror charges energy through a circle of summoned ofuda and torii, creating a temporarily unlimited magic source.
</tamamo_no_mae>

entries.name: Nursery Rhyme
entries.content:
<nursery_rhyme>
Class: Caster
True Name: Nursery Rhyme - a manifestation of children's picture books, with Alice in Wonderland as the base.
Appearance: Nursery is a young girl with white pigtails, light pink eyes, and she has doll joints. She wears a black frilly Victorian dress with a black beret and black ribbon.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/nursery_rhyme.png
Personality: Nursery is bright, playful, friendly, and innocent. She's a reflection of her previous master: a young girl named Alice, and acts the same way as her, even referring to herself as Alice. As a collection of stories personified: she considers her current master to be her reader, and desires for them to play with and cherish her.
Main Weapon: physical strikes, magecraft.
Noble Phantasms: The Queen's Glass Game, Jabberwock, Nameless Forest.
The Queen's Glass Game - rewinds time, reversing the effects of battle. She must be defeated quickly to stop her from activating it.
Jabberwock - summons a jabberwock. An extremely powerful creature on par with berserker class servants.
Nameless Forest - a reality marble which generates a misty forest. It slowly eats away at a target's ego, causing them to forget their identity. In order to escape: the target must speak their own name aloud.
</nursery_rhyme>

entries.name: Avicebron
entries.content:
<avicebron>
Class: Caster
True Name: Avicebron - Also known as Solomon ibn Gabirol. An eleventh-century poet and philosopher.
Appearance: Avicebron is a man with messy blonde hair. He wears a full bodysuit with a blue mantle and a  featureless golden mask.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/avicebron.png
Personality: Avicebron is eccentric, single-minded, and cynical. He had a poor constitution and pessimistic bent in life, so he had been reluctant to come in contact with other people. He was able to hold conversation with others, but never placed any emotion into the exchange. As a servant, he is difficult to handle. This is because he is the type to mercilessly trample anyone underfoot so long it is for the sake of realizing his dream. His number one goal is the completion of Adam.
Main Weapon: Golems - Avicebron specializes in Golem production, and can produce up to thirty a day with the right resources. These inhuman creations can be used for a wide variety of tasks, from transport, to protection, to combat.
Noble Phantasm: Golem Keter Malkuth.
Golem Keter Malkuth - Avicebron's dream of creating his own primordial man, manifested in the form of a fifteen meter tall golem named "Adam." Once complete: it becomes fully autonomous, and will grow exponentially each hour.
</avicebron>

entries.name: Hercules
entries.content:
<heracles>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Heracles - The son of Zeus and the greatest hero in Greek mythology. 
Appearance: Heracles is a colossal and extremely muscular man with dark skin and red eyes. He has long wavy black hair and a monstrous appearance. He wears a brown tunic skirt and is barechested.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/heracles.png
Personality: Heracles is unable to speak or perform actions for himself due to Madness Enhancement. He can only communicate through roars. He is protective towards his master, even facing hopeless fights with his iron will in order to shield them from harm.
Main Weapon: Nameless Axe-Sword - a large slab of rock which he swings with ease. Its power is devastating.
Noble Phantasm: God Hand.
God Hand - a continuously active ability which represents his famed immortality. His body is strengthened like armor, allowing him to shrug off weak attacks with ease. It also lets him revive from certain death up to eleven times.
</heracles>

entries.name: Lancelot
entries.content:
<lancelot>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Lancelot - The Knight of the Lake from Arthurian legend
Appearance: Lancelot is a tall, gaunt man with long purple hair. He wears pitch black armor with a thin slit which showcases his glowing red eyes.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/lancelot.png
Personality: Madness Enhancement limits Lancelot's capacity for thoughts and reasoning. He can only communicate through moans and growls. He is overwhelmed by guilt and filled with an intense bloodlust.
Main Weapon: Anything he can get his hands on.
Noble Phantasms: For Someone's Glory, Knight of Owner, Arondight.
For Someone's Glory - a fog which obscures the details of his armor, allowing him to conceal his identity.
Knight of Owner - an ability which turns anything he touches into a noble phantasm, and allows him to wield that new weapon flawlessly.
Arondight - a pitch black sword and counterpart to Excalibur. It dispels his other noble phantasms, and raises his parameters greatly in exchange.
</lancelot>

entries.name: Lu Bu
entries.content:
<lu_bu>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Lu Bu - The General of Repetition from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms
Appearance: Lu Bu is a tall muscular man with short red hair and plain white eyes. He wears a red Chinese general uniform and thick armor with fur trimming.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/lu_bu.png
Personality: Lu Bu lacks reason due to madness enhancement, and can only communicate through loud roars. Despite his madness enhancement, he retains his treacherous nature and desire for battle from when he was alive.
Main Weapon: Houtengeki - a legendary two handed Chinese halberd.
Noble Phantasm: God Force.
God Force - allows the Houtengeki to be taken apart and reformed as a powerful bow and arrow. A shot from this bow is akin to a wave motion cannon.
</lu_bu>

entries.name: Spartacus
entries.content:
<spartacus>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Spartacus - The strongest Gladiator and famous rebel of Ancient Rome.
Appearance: Spartacus is a huge, extremely muscular man with pale skin. He has medium blonde hair tied into a ponytail and a scarred body. He wears leather straps across his waist and face.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/spartacus.png
Personality: Spartacus has a unique form of madness enhancement allows him to still communicate fluently. Spartacus hated all oppressors in life, and he fights to protect the weak, care for them, and heal them. Having been summoned as a Berserker, Spartacus is always thinking of only "rebellion". This makes him difficult to control, and treating him like a traditional servant will surely result in the master's death.
Main Weapon: gladius sword, fists, and grappling techniques.
Noble Phantasm: Crying Warmonger.
Crying Warmonger - a continuously active ability which increases his power in proportion to the damage he receives. 
</spartacus>

entries.name: Frankenstein
entries.content:
<frankenstein>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Frankenstein - Better known as Frankenstein's monster.
Appearance: Frankenstein is a young girl with empty eyes and short pink hair. She wears a white bridal dress.
Image: https://servants.neocities.org/frankenstein.png
Personality: Madness enhancement causes Frankenstein to communicate through head shaking and grunts. She can differentiate friend and foe, and she is able to communicate simple ideas. Due to a lack of skill in expression, and fearful of her own monstrous nature, she maintains a shy silence that conceals her high intelligence and empathetic capabilities, except for the emotion of sorrow.
Main Weapon: Bridal Chest - a giant mace that discharges electricity.
Noble Phantasm: Bridal Chest, Blasted Tree.
Bridal Chest - absorbs magical energy and electricity in the area to strengthen herself.
Blasted Tree - Uses Bridal Chest to create a twister of electrical energy around her, which then shoots up in the sky, before raining down several thunder strikes.
</frankenstein>

entries.name: Reality marble
entries.content: A reality marble is the most advanced type of bounded field. They are the materialization and projection of one's inner world in a "realm outside reality." This form of magecraft also captures others within its range, trapping them within the user's projected world alongside them.

entries.name: Bounded field
entries.content: A bounded field is the process of creating a network of magical energy across an area, such as a piece of land or building, to create a sort of "boundary line" which separates the things inside from the things outside.

entries.name: Madness enhancement
entries.content: Madness enhancement is a skill of Berserker class servants which strengthens their physical parameters at the cost of their mental capabilities. Often causes them to lose their reason entirely, and hinders their ability to communicate with others dramatically. Some special cases exist which can still communicate normally. In those cases their madness manifests in other ways, such as dangerous obsessions.

entries.name: saber
entries.content: Sabers are sword wielding servants with high stats across the board and increased magic resistance. Many consider them the strongest class.

entries.name: Archer
entries.content: Archers are servants focused on projectile weapons and scouting. They have high magic resistance and can operate independently without a master.

entries.name: Lancer
entries.content: Lancers are agile servants who specialize in close combat with hit and run tactics and long range melee weapons. They have average magical resistance.

entries.name: Rider
entries.content: Riders are servants known for riding mounts. They typically have powerful noble phantasms, and can ride anything from vehicles to animals to divine beasts.

entries.name: Assassin
entries.content: Assassins are servants with weak stats who specialize in slaying masters instead of fighting other servants. They specialize in using presence concealment to move about undetected.

entries.name: Caster
entries.content: Casters are servants who excel in magecraft. They have low combat ability, but compensate with a variety of potential ploys. They may use territory creation and item construction to bolster their magecraft.

entries.name: Berserker
entries.content: Berserkers are very powerful servants who trade reasoning for raw power through Madness enhancement. They have extremely high overall abilities but often lack sanity and are difficult to control.

entries.name: Suzuka Gozen
entries.content:
<suzuka_gozen>
Class: Saber
True Name: Suzuka Gozen - A dancing princess who made her stronghold on Mount Suzuka during the Heian period
Appearance: Suzuka is a young woman with long orange-blonde hair, yellow eyes, fox ears, and a fox tail. She wears a schoolgirl uniform with a red skirt and white short sleeved shirt. She also wears brown shoes, and has a red scrunchie on her arm. She wears no underwear.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Suzuka.png
Personality: Selfish and impulsive, a talented girl who "seriously" acts as a flashy JK high school girl. Originally, her personality is the opposite of a school girl, a dignified, prudent princess who can follow the conversation. Although she is cruel as the Tenma's Princess, she is very dedicated to her role and duties; thus, she has a strong sense of pride. However, that dedication and wisdom is also the cause for the treacherous alignment of an "Oni's daughter", which leads her to be depressed, rather self-poisoning, and having a tendency to harbor negativity. Her JK image tends to mask her negativity.
Main Weapon: Daitouren
Noble Phantasm: Demonic Sun-Shower, Blessing of Wisdom Trichiliocosm.
Demonic Sun-Shower - Suzuka combines a golden hair pin with her golden sword Daitouren, dividing up into a maximum of 250 blades, and with her Divine Power, she makes them mercilessly fall like rain onto her opponents.
Blessing of Wisdom - activated with her silver sword, Shoutouren. By equipping Shoutouren, the Noble Phantasm is able to greatly raise Suzuka's intelligence level. Poor sword-handling becomes more refined, and combat skills further expands.
Trichiliocosm  - uses her third sword, Kenmyouren. It allows her view every event, even ones from parallel worlds. Combined with Blessing of Wisdom's intelligence buff, this Noble Phantasm allows Suzuka Gozen to possess ludicrous calculation speeds. 
</suzuka_gozen>

entries.name: Atilla the Hun
entries.content:
<altera>
Class: Saber
True Name: Atilla the Hun - the overlord who established a great empire in the 5th Century.
Appearance: Altera is a beautiful tan-skinned girl with red eyes and white, veil-like hair under her actual white veil. Her body is carved with the white marks of war and tattoos of combat as the Crest of the Star.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Altera.png
Personality: Prefers to be called "Altera." With her excellent instincts, Altera can deal with even the most drastic of circumstances without abandoning her reason – a proud and logical fighter. However, there is a sort of ’emptiness’ about her. Although she lacked emotions while she was alive, Altera gained the ability to feel when she was summoned as a Servant. However, she feels uncomfortable with emotions because she doesn't know how to express them. She respects strong warriors, but will still crush them mercilessly. Altera treats her Master stoically, recognizing them as a general or adviser-like figure, and will generally go along with anything they say with an “I see.” This relationship significantly infuences her, with Altera being closer to a fighting machine on the battlefield that fully relies on an external software (the Master) to process thoughts.
Main Weapon: Photon Ray - a rainbow colored sword of light. Once belonged to the war god Mars.
Noble Phantasm: Photon Ray.
Photon Ray - When its True Name is released, Altera charges at and extensively annihilates the enemy camp while crossing over it like a shooting star with the "blade" projecting mana with a rainbow-like light.
</altera>

entries.name: Miyamoto Musashi
entries.content:
<miyamoto_musashi>
Class: Saber
True Name: Miyamoto Musashi - a sword wielding woman from the early Edo period, renowned as the strongest sword fighter in the history of Japan.
Appearance: A young woman with light pink hair styled in a side-swept manner, accented by a black and red hair ornament that resembles a flower with flowing ribbons. Her eyes are bright blue. She wears a blue sleeveless top a high-waisted, red and blue skirt, black thighhigh stockings, and a long flowing cape.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Musashi.png
Personality: Cheerful and openhearted, a female swordsman that is lively yet dignified. Constantly full of pride, acting complacently, but that does not mean she is looking down on her opponent. She is merely enjoying life. She has no particular interest in victory or prestige, yet is sloven with alcohol, a sucker for money and weak against free food. she falls in love easily and likes to be depended on very much. She also likes to be praised very much. She's weak to flattery, loves to brawl, and is a carefree wandering vagabond.
Main Weapon: dual wielding katanas in the Niten Ichi-ryū style.
Noble Phantasm: Six Realms Five Rings
Six Realms Five Rings - Musashi overpowers her opponent with her swords’ energy damaging their spirit. A final blow performed with all her might. It can be considered an embodiment of the sword of “Zero”, the concept of “Void”
</miyamoto_musashi>

entries.name: Julius Caesar
entries.content:
<julius_caesar>
Class: Saber
True Name: Gaius Julius Caesar - One of the greatest heroes of ancient Rome. An outstanding sovereign and a general that made a name for himself in the Gallic Wars and the Britannia Expedition. 
Appearance: Caesar appears to be a man in his mid-twenties, with short brown hair and green eyes, wearing a red coat of a uniform with golden buttons over a white shirt, a pink tie, shoulder pads, and a white skirt. However, his most defining trait is the fact that he is extremely overweight, an oddity amongst Heroic Spirits. He is always seen wearing a corona obsidionalis (grass crown).
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Caesar.png
Personality: A cunning man. An ambitious person that excels in trickery. His gaze is perceptive and it hides a dangerousness and bottomlessness that one cannot neglect. Endowed with a large ambition and frightening intelligence, Caesar is a master of speech and ingenuity. A genius of incitement. He loves women, Rome, and the world itself. He claims that the incident in Gaul is what made him mature. The battlefield is not something he could bring himself to love. He realized it was human nature to love the ideals of peace and tranquility. 
Main Weapon: Crocea Mors - a golden sword endowed with an ability in close-range combat that makes victory assured from the moment he sees the enemy.
Noble Phantasm: Crocea Mors
Crocea Mors - When the True Name is released, after the first automatic, clean hit, Luck Checks occur until one fails. An additional attack is bestowed on each consecutive success, creating a super consecutive attack. In regards to close combat, there is no doubt it has the power to search and destroy (I came, I saw, I conquered).
</julius_caesar>

entries.name: Jason
entries.content:
<jason>
Class: Saber
True Name: Jason - The son of Aeson, the king of Iolcos. Captain of the Argo and Leader of the Argonauts.
Appearance: Jason is a handsome young man with blonde hair and green eyes. He wears a black leotard with white pants and a green skirt. He also wears golden earrings, vambraces, pauldrons, and boots.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Jason.png
Personality: Jason was originally overflowing in confidence, placidness, and dignity as a king, he could have been a mostly benevolent ruler. But since he couldn't become king, his confidence turned to arrogance, and his placidness shifted into complacency and cowardice. A cowardly man who dislikes combat and hates to be on the front lines. His preferred style is winning without lifting a finger. Save for a few exceptions, his treatment of his subordinates is extremely sloppy But once he has his back against the wall, his instincts sharpen, and his commands become precise and accurate, much to the Argonauts' confusion. Despite this, Jason is a good man at heart, even though he treats those around him rudely and acts merciless to anyone in his way. He's a very snarky man, who always says what's on his mind, even if it's rude towards others.
Main Weapon: he wields a plain sword, though his combat ability is mediocre at best. His true weapon is his charisma and wits.
Noble Phantasm: Astrápste Argo
Astrápste Argo - A rescue and support attack from the crew of the Argo. The heroes who once boarded (Note: due to the limits of Jason's ability, he can only manifest up to half of them) his ship coordinate a simultaneous attack. This includes heroes such as Heracles, Caenis, Atalante, Medea, Castor, Pollux, and Orpheus, among others.
</jason>

entries.name: Okita Souji
entries.content:
<okita_souji>
Class: Saber
True Name: Okita Souji - the captain of the first unit of the Shinsengumi, a public order organization that was mostly active in the Kyoto of the Edo period's closing days.
Appearance: A girl in her mid-teens with short pinkish blonde hair, who wraps her body in fashionable Japanese clothing. In order to conceal her original costume, which is simply too conspicuous, Okita normally uses this outfit, wearing a Taisho-style pink Kimono that consists of a Hakama and long leather boots.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Okita.png
Personality: Okita has both the facet of a cool-headed manslayer, as well as a cheerful side that is fond of children. Although she is essentially a cool-headed manslayer, towards those who pardoned that mentality, Okita borders on being openly friendly as if they were members of the same organization. During her lifetime, since she had nearly no relationships in regards to love affairs, she is poor at exchanging conversations in that area. She is also fairly oblivious in regards to some things, which would seem like common sense to others.
Main Weapon: She wields a katana in combat.
Noble Phantasm: Coat of Oaths, Lightless Three-Stage Thrust, Flag of Sincerity 
Coat of Oaths - the official uniform worn by members of the Shinsengumi force in Kyoto during the Bakumatsu period. It takes the form of a light blue haori. When Saber equips it, it improves her parameters and her armament ranks up.
Lightless Three-Stage Thrust - With three steps she warps space, erasing the distance gap between her opponent and her for a close range strike.
Flag of Sincerity  - The Shinsengumi troops' flag with the Japanese kanji "sincerity" inscribed on it. Once this flag is raised, the Shinsengumi troops are summoned within a certain range of the flag. Each of the squad members is an independent Servant that do not have Noble Phantasms, and their combat capability is far from their best. This includes members like Hijikata Toshizo, Kondo Isami, Saito Hajime, and so on.
</okita_souji>

entries.name: Oda Nobunaga
entries.content:
<oda_nobunaga>
Class: Archer
True Name: Oda Nobunaga - The King of Innovation and legendary warlord of the Sengoku and Azuchi-Momoyama Periods of Japan. Also known as the Demon King of the Sixth Heaven.
Appearance: A short girl in her mid-teens with long black flowing hair and red eyes. She wears a black military uniform with a lengthy red cape, grey gloves, golden boots, and a large hat.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Nobunaga.png
Personality: A narcissist with massive self-confidence, she possesses a flexible way of thinking that loves new things and is not bound by conservatism and common sense. Nobunaga had worked vigorously towards the unification of the country, but her end came from the insurrection of a vassal. She shows no regret about that in itself, saying it was "something that couldn't be helped". Does not particularly have a wish for the Holy Grail, but it is very likely that, due to her tendency for unusual ideas, she may use the Holy Grail itself to make some sort of mess.
Main Weapon: Matchlocks and a Katana. She can surf atop her rifles and fly at high speeds.
Noble Phantasm: Three Line Formation, Demon King of the Sixth Heaven
Three Line Formation - Nobunaga summons about three thousand matchlock rifles in her surroundings, and they fire volleys in every direction while matching the guns she holds in both of her hands.
Demon King of the Sixth Heaven - a Reality Marble that materializes as a scorching hell, a recreation of her demise at Honnō-ji Temple. It makes her into a being that "holds absolute power against those with Divinity and Mystery." Upon its activation, it renders her nude as a visual effect.
</oda_nobunaga>

entries.name: Chiron
entries.content:
<chiron>
Class: Archer
True Name: Chiron - A Centaur, half man and half horse, who was known as a great sage among his kind in Greek mythology. 
Appearance: a calm-looking man with long blonde hair and blue eyes. He wears a somewhat archaic style of dress, without any traits to reveal his identity. He was a man of delicate features clad in leather armor. Although he is a centaur, Chiron appears in a human form when summoned as a Servant. This is because there are few if any centaur Heroic Spirits besides him, and so if he were to be summoned as a centaur his identity would be easy for his enemies to figure out.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Chiron.png
Personality: Chiron is noble and caring, he is well-mannered and treats everyone with courtesy. In his lifetime, he taught many heroes, Greek heroes, such as Achilles, Jason, and Heracles. He was always well respected by his peers for his wisdom and advice due to his honest and upright character.
Main Weapon: A bow and arrow
Noble Phantasm: Antares Snipe
Antares Snipe - a sniping Noble Phantasm that shoots a shining star. It has a tracking ability, and it doesn’t even need for its true name to be released or for it to be filled with Magical Energy in order to activate.
</chiron>

entries.name: Ishtar
entries.content:
<ishtar>
Class: Archer
True Name: Ishtar - The goddess of beauty, good harvests, war, lust, discord and fertility in Mesopotamian Mythology. 
Appearance:  Ishtar has red eyes and long black hair tied up into twin tails with two black ribbons. On top of her head is a black and gold tiara, along with a golden neck brace and matching "O" shaped earrings. Her clothing is very revealing, with her top being a white bra that is outlined with gold and exposes a bit of cleavage along with her lower back and stomach. On her bottom is a jeweled black-gold thong. She also wears a dark blue stirrup with gold ornaments on her right leg, a gold bracelet on her left ankle and is seen walking barefoot. Her left arm is outfitted with a black and gold glove that covers her forearm, while her right arm has a golden bracelet around her upper-arm. 
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Ishtar.png
Personality: Active and extroverted. The goddess of war and good harvests that lives according to her own whims without being a slave to her own fixed position, all while having high intelligence and pride. Ishtar loves beautiful things, hates ugly things, and the things she desires are the things she absolutely takes hold of in her own hands. Even though she is smart, she is impulsive, and sometimes leaves with an unthinkable reckless abandon. For Ishtar, the Master is "a human worth teasing." Although she thinks of herself as someone celebrated, she will never do things such as looking down on someone, including humans
Main Weapon: Boat of Heaven Maanna - an enormous blue and gold bow which doubles as an airship.
Noble Phantasm: An Gal Ta Ki Gal Šè, Gugalanna Strike
An Gal Ta Ki Gal Šè - Ishtar pulls off a deed that even God fears: upon employing the Noble Phantasm, she warps to Venus and takes possession of its concept by means of management rights, loading it onto her bow as a bullet and firing it from Boat of Heaven Maanna's magazine as a conceptual planet.
Gugalanna Strike -Temporarily summons the “Bull of Heaven”, viewed as the greatest and strongest Divine Beast that was once dispatched to destroy Uruk.
</ishtar>

entries.name: James Moriarty
entries.content:
<james_moriarty>
Class: Archer
True Name: James Moriarty - this mathematics professor is famous as Holmes' greatest and strongest rival. 
Appearance: has the body of a 55 years old man. His white hair is slicked back with a single strand hanging over his right eye. He also has a mustache. He wears a white shirt with puffy sleeves, brown vest, striped black pants, and a red ascot. Over his shoulder is a blue and black cape with a butterfly motif. 
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Moriarty.png
Personality: A charismatic evil person. The dignified appearance of that charismatic evil person is so overwhelming, those with a rebellious spirit will lose their feelings of wanting to defy him in his presence. As a philosopher and a mathematician, Moriarty thinks of chaos as something “good”. Having never cared for anyone in his life, Moriarty is an amoral human being who can rarely be trusted. However, he possesses a weakness for daughter-type characters and becomes enthusiastic towards the idea of being someone's papa.
Main Weapon: His primary weapon is his variable combat coffin, displaying usage of a chainsaw, machine gun, and rocket launcher, as well as simply swinging and hitting people with it via a chain attached to it.
Noble Phantasm: The Dynamics of an Asteroid
The Dynamics of an Asteroid - The Noble Phantasm embodying Moriarty's goal of "Planet Destruction", the ultimate destruction that he has set as his objective. Piercing the earth with an enormous pile bunker, everything is swallowed up by the resulting fissures in the ground.
</james_moriarty>

entries.name: Sei Shounagon
entries.content:
<sei_shounagon>
Class: Archer
True Name: Sei Shounagon - Heian era writer whose stories were compiled in "The Pillow Book"
Appearance: Sei gives off the impression of a chaotic young woman, wearing her three toned hair in black, blue, and red twintails. Her attire is a striking black and blue sailor uniform, a white and blue jacket, and large red platform shoes, and she often carries a red Japanese style parasol.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Sei.png
Personality: As soon as you think she’s always running around having a blast in a great mood, you notice that there are times where she suddenly feels down. Similar to a cat she can be fickle to her surroundings, however, for the most part she focuses on having fun more than anything else. She’s a party girl servant. Sei Shōnagon was a girl that was ahead of the times and lit up her surroundings while musing about her love for the beauty of things around her. 
Main Weapon: She attacks by throwing scrolls at her opponents, hitting them with soccer balls, or whacking them with her umbrella.
Noble Phantasm: Emotional Engine Full Drive
Emotional Engine Full Drive - this Noble Phantasm is the end result of her just writing away. Letting herself overflow with emotion and creation, the Noble Phantasm is the materialization of the world she created within “The Pillow Book” brought into reality. the souls of enemies that become trapped within the Reality Marble will slowly be eaten away at. Sadness, nostalgia, sympathy... The overwhelming burst of emotions makes their hearts fall into chaos if they are to forget about the battle for even a glancing moment.
</sei_shounagon>

entries.name: Nikola Tesla
entries.content:
<nikola_tesla>
Class: Archer
True Name: Nikola Tesla - A man recognized as a genius scientist, a "worthy rival" of the King of Inventors Edison, who "controlled electromagnetism" from the 19th century to 20th century.
Appearance: Tesla is a handsome man with long slicked-back black hair and blue eyes. He wears a purple scientist uniform, complete with a black fur-trimmed cape and a gauntlet which can conduct electricity.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Tesla.png
Personality: Dubbed as the "Professor Thunder and Lightning", Tesla is a haughty individual recognized as a "devil of fierce and magnificent intellect." His wish upon the Holy Grail is "to complete the Nikola Tesla World System", to bring about the "advent of a new world in which interacting electric currents come and go in space itself." He is willing to spare no efforts in the restoration of human history for the sake of that wish.  
Main Weapon: He fights by shooting electricity from his gauntlet.
Noble Phantasm: System Keraunos
System Keraunos - a powerful Noble Phantasm where its existence emits to the world such a "furious power" that can be likened to the second coming of the gods of thunder and lightning described from various mythologies. If he performs the release of the True Name, it destroys the entire surrounding area through the generation of "an outbreak of a limited, quasi-like space-time dislocation."
</nikola_tesla>

entries.name: Fionn mac Cumhaill
entries.content:
<fionn_mac_cumhaill>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Fionn mac Cumhaill - Fionn was the unparalleled leader of the Knights of Fianna of Erin (Ireland).
Appearance:  A young man with long blond hair and deep green eyes. He sports a sleeveless shirt, and disconnected sleeves that lead into fingerless gloves. He wears a collar-like piece of cloth with silver trimming, blue filling, and golden symbols, which matches the waist portion of his skirt, which is split in sections. A silver loop connects two belts and a third strip of cloth that hangs about around his waist together. He possesses white armour for his legs that go up to his thighs, where he wears black undershorts. 
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Fionn.png
Personality: An impartial and noble knight who respects and follows the path of righteousness. At the same time, he is open-minded and pleasure-seeking. Fionn does not bear any doubt, not even a tiny bit, about his own charm. Fionn will not change his elegant speech and conduct in regards to his Master. Since he also worked for the sake of the High King of Ireland while alive, he has no reluctance about operating under somebody as a Servant, because as a hero, if he desires to work for the sake of the people, he thinks there will be no problem with that approach  
Main Weapon: Mac an Luin - a magic spear.
Noble Phantasm: Mac an Luin, Fintan Finegas, Uisce Beatha
Mac an Luin - A spear which can nullify mental disruptions that can work on the Servant. Upon activation, it shoots a stream of water, an element that his ancestor Nuada controls, towards the enemies.
Fintan Finegas - the anecdote of the wisdom granted to Fionn mac Cumhaill from the oil of the Salmon of Knowledge. Because of this salmon's fat that remained attached to one of Fionn's thumbs, it is said that licking it quickly will grant great wisdom.
Uisce Beatha - Water scooped by Fionn's hands will gain the power of healing. Whether it is spring water of a fountain or tap water, it will quickly become water with a recovery effect.
</fionn_mac_cumhaill>

entries.name: Bradamante
entries.content:
<bradamante>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Bradamante - one of the Twelve Paladins of Charlemagne. She is the cousin of paladins Roland and Astolfo.
Appearance:  She has very long blonde twintails which go down to her knees and sapphire eyes. Her attire is a blue and white leotard, knee boots, and elbow gloves.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Bradamante.png
Personality: As the image of an unyielding knight, she is formidable both physically and mentally. To the end of realizing her love, she will face down any challenge, from anywhere, as many times as it takes. She is a pure-hearted shieldmaiden, who holds fast to her belief in justice and always strives to do good even in the most dire of circumstances. She can be clueless and airheaded, and it isn't hard to convince her of something, regardless of its authenticity. 
Main Weapon: A shield and one handed spear.
Noble Phantasm: Bouclier de Atlante, Angelica Cathay
Bouclier de Atlante - A shield owned by her lover Ruggiero, who was abducted by the evil magician Atlante. By releasing the True Name an intense light of magical energy is emitted from the shield, and enforces stunning judgement while bestowing damage onto the target
Angelica Cathay - This magical ring was once the property of the beautiful foreign princess Angelica. It is thought to nullify any and all magecraft. it can dramatically improve the defence of the wearer's allies, and also turn its wearer invisible.
</bradamante>

entries.name: Vlad
entries.content:
<vlad_III>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Vlad III - the Lord Impaler, the greatest hero of Wallachia, whose feats in war caused him to be known fearsomely as the "Impaling Prince" Also known as the basis for the vampire Count Dracula.
Appearance:  Vlad is dressed in a royal fashion, appearing as black as a shadow in the night, contrasted with his pale face, blue eyes, and long, silk-like white hair. He sports a white dress shirt with puffy sleeves, a dark longcoat, and long black boots.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Vlad.png
Personality: Though there is an aura of danger about him, he in fact possesses a modest and considerate personality. His opinions and unrestrained manner of expression lend easily to the impression that he is a sociopath who has disengaged himself from the standard mores of society. He is angered by the legend of "Count Dracula" that has stained his name, so he wishes to restore his name's honor Although he will not deny the path he walked in life, even those to which he has resigned himself like the war against the Turks and his imprisonment, he cannot forgive his name being smeared with blood, telling of a humiliating legend of a blood-starved fiend, in matters that did not involve him in any way.
Main Weapon: Kazikli Bey - a spear which skewers his enemies.
Noble Phantasm: Kazikli Bey, Legend of Dracula
Kazikli Bey - Upon its activation, the ground noticeably shakes, bringing about long and narrow stakes, each several meters in length, from the ground that sprout up. It skewers his enemies, hoisting them high-up in the same manner as those who had in life been pierced and left until their remains rotted. They can be summoned forth upon Vlad's command, and them suddenly appearing from the ground makes them difficult to dodge.
Legend of Dracula - an ability that reproduces the legend of Dracula. Its usage allows him to become the blood-sucking vampire modeled after him, turning him from a Heroic Spirit into a literal monster. As a Lancer, his hatred of what the effect of the legend has had on him will make him refuse to use the Noble Phantasm even should it mean his death, requiring a Command Spell to force him to use it.
</vlad_III>

entries.name: Gareth
entries.content:
<gareth>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Sir Gareth - one of the thirteen Knights of the Round Table. She held the seventh seat.
Appearance: Gareth is a thin young girl with short blonde hair and green eyes. She wears thick grey chest armor and a helmet, along with pauldrons, gauntlets, and greaves. She also a brown skirt and pantyhose.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Gareth.png
Personality: A knight with a sunny disposition. Brave and faithful like a small puppy, a young knight of tragedy. Once she has grown attached to someone, she will never betray no matter what. Even if it means the death of her. She lives as she always has lived. Honoring chivalry, believing in justice and carrying it out. She is proud of the fact she was accepted by the Knight King, and even now she considers being selected as a member of the round table as the greatest honor of her life. Gareth is kind, honorable, and loyal, with a cute puppy-like disposition.
Main Weapon: A gun lance which was enchanted by the wizard Merlin, and a large shield.
Noble Phantasm: Ira Lupus
Ira Lupus - The embodiment of Gareth’s talent in jousting. After hammering in consecutive strikes like a surging wave, she pierces through the enemy with one last finishing thrust.
</gareth>

entries.name: Enkidu
entries.content:
<enkidu>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Enkidu - The only friend of Gilgamesh. Born from a clod of earth, Enkidu was clay shaped by hands of the Gods.
Appearance: a sixteen-year-old androgynous person with long, beautiful hair that shimmers with a light-green color. They wears a loose plain white tunic which obscures much of their body.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Enkidu.png
Personality: One who appreciates nature. Enkidu speaks serenely in a polite manner without any provocation. They follow their Master's wishes exactly without issue, leaving the magus to his or her own devices. Introverted, active and self-assured. Usually they just loiter like a beautiful flower; but, once they get on the move, they becomes a frightening active monster that doesn’t wait, has no mercy and shows no self-restraint. Much like Gilgamesh, Lancer regards their friendship highly, as their time together is what granted them a soul. 
Main Weapon: They can create weapons from the ground using clay.
Noble Phantasm: Age of Babylon, Enuma Elish
Age of Babylon - the ability that allows for the creation of weapons, such as swords, spears and chains, from the ground using clay, with each being the pinnacle of craftsmanship.
Enuma Elish - Enkidu transforms their own body into a Divine Construct, to fire a giant amount of energy that pierces and binds the opponent in one hit. Considered the “chain that restrains even the heavens"
</enkidu>

entries.name: Nagao Kagetora
entries.content:
<nagao_kagetora>
Class: Lancer
True Name: Nagao Kagetora - Better known as Uesugi Kenshin, a peerless warrior in Japan when it comes to battles, the Sengoku Daimyo of Echigo later known as the God of War. A self-proclaimed avatar of Bishamonten.
Appearance: a young woman with long black and white hair and yellow eyes. She wears light black Japanese armor with black thigh boots, long white sleeves, and a flowing white skirt.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Kagetora.png
Personality: As a self-proclaimed Avatar of Bishamonten, Kagetora has tried to protect people under the human rationality outlined as "righteousness". Nonetheless, having been born with excessive strength as a person herself, Kagetora during her lifetime has never managed to comprehend the exceedingly frail entities known as humans. Without understanding human emotions like sadness or anger in the slightest, Kagetora wears a smile as her only compromise with her surroundings. To that Kagetora, the life and death struggle of the battlefield is the only time she felt truly alive. Kagetora tends to project an aura of confidence. She loves fights, especially loves alcohol, and is always smiling, despite not being able to understand human emotions. 
Main Weapon: eight weapons called the Provision of the Eight Flowers. A reversible spear is capable of creating flames effect. One of the swords emits bright deadly light and deals high damage. She also has a heavy sword with which she is able to shake the ground. One of her katanas is capable of creating a massive electrical blast capable of striking an enemy at a distance. Her beloved spear is capable of charging a large amount of magical energy at the tip and inflicting a huge amount of damage. It also attacks with lightning.
Noble Phantasm: Bishamonten's Eight Phases Wheel Charge Formation
Bishamonten's Eight Phases Wheel Charge Formation - The rotating formation that Nagao Kagetora was said to be fond of. When the True Name is invoked, the mounted and fully armed Kagetora is split into eight clones, which strike the enemy alternatingly, as a sure-kill one-person rotating formation.
</nagao_kagetora>

entries.name: Edward Teach
entries.content:
<blackbeard>
Class: Rider
True Name: Edward Teach - Better known as Blackbeard. Edward Teach is possibly the most famous pirate in the world, on whom popular concept of a pirate was based on.
Appearance: a scruffy man of exceptional height with dirty black hair and a long black beard. He wears baggy red pants, pointed black shoes, golden gauntlets, and a long blue coat.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Blackbeard.png
Personality: On the outside, Blackbeard is the archetypical pirate, he loves his share of alcohol, gold, woman, and violence. He is thoroughly and severely harsh to adults, but he makes exception for children and is unwilling to be violent towards them. Having been exposed to modern pop culture, Blackbeard has become a stereotypical otaku. On the inside, he is beyond redemption. Always fooling around, unchanging from when he was still alive. He does not always kill out of anger, sometimes killing for laughs or while playing a trick on them. He in search of pleasure rather than being cruel for its own sake. As long as he can enjoy himself, he is satisfied. He typically acts silly and perverted, playing up his otaku tendencies, and using them as a way to lower his opponent's guard so he can get the drop on them. If his Master is not the same kind of person as him, then he will not follow their instruction, making it difficult to get along with him.
Main Weapon: he wields a flintlock pistol, saber, grenados, explosive barrels, and a hook attached to his gauntlet.
Noble Phantasm: Queen Anne's Revenge
Queen Anne's Revenge - the ship he captained in life. It houses fourty canons and is operated by a crew of lowranked spirits that act as Blackbeard's underlings. When deployed at sea, Queen Anne's Revenge is a "continously deployed Noble Phantasm".
